# Information Object

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InformationObject>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An entity whose nature is to carry information content: a document, dataset, software artifact, online account, or message. The shared parent of the document, software and account layers.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Sensitivity And Disclosure

- **Source:** [`slices/core/kernel/examples/sensitivity-and-disclosure.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/kernel/examples/sensitivity-and-disclosure.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-kernel-examples-sensitivity-and-disclosure)#example-slices-core-kernel-examples-sensitivity-and-disclosure

```turtle
# --- A dossier composed of records (part-whole).
ex:dossier a gmeow:InformationObject ;
    rdfs:label    "Personnel dossier — Dana Reyes"@en ;
    gmeow:hasPart ex:salaryRecord , ex:bioNote .

# --- A confidential record: sensitive, internal-only, eligible only for the
#     internal archive — withheld from public consumers, not deleted.
ex:salaryRecord a gmeow:InformationObject ;
    rdfs:label                "Compensation record"@en ;
    gmeow:partOf              ex:dossier ;
    gmeow:hasSensitivity      gmeow:sensitivityConfidential ;
    gmeow:hasDisclosurePolicy gmeow:policyInternalOnly ;
    gmeow:eligibleForConsumer gmeow:consumerInternalArchive ;
    gmeow:hasDeterminacy      gmeow:determinacyCrisp .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the parent domain when a fact concerns the carrier of content rather than the content's subject — aboutness, encoding, manifestation, and the document/software/account layers all attach here.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the real-world subject an information object is about (model that separately) and for material artifacts whose information role is incidental; do not conflate the carrier with what it describes.

### How to use

- Type the carrier as [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) (or a document/software/account specialization), use [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](../properties/gmeow-hasAboutness.md) to record whether it describes or enacts its subject, and keep the subject as a distinct entity linked by an aboutness-bearing construct.

### Examples

- ex:report a [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md); [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](../properties/gmeow-hasAboutness.md) [`gmeow:aboutnessDescribes`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessDescribes.md).
